    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call.

    Implements the Toolformer loss-filter procedure T01–T05.
    """

    # Validate inputs
    for name, arr in [
        ("logp_with_result", logp_with_result),
        ("logp_call_only",   logp_call_only),
        ("logp_no_call",     logp_no_call),
    ]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray) or arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D NumPy array, got {type(arr)} and ndim {getattr(arr, 'ndim', None)}")
        if arr.size == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
        if not np.isfinite(arr).all():
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains non-finite values")
        if (arr > 0).any():
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values")

    # Check shape consistency
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("All three log-probability arrays must have the same shape")

    # Validate tau_filter
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")
    if not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float)):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative float")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite")
    if tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be nonnegative")

    n_candidates, future_horizon = logp_with_result.shape

    # T01: Normalize decreasing future-token weights
    t = np.arange(future_horizon, dtype=float)
    raw = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    if raw.sum() == 0:
        raise ValueError("Future horizon yields zero total weight")
    norm_weights = raw / raw.sum()

    # T02: Compute weighted future-token loss (negative weighted log prob)
    loss_with_result = -np.dot(logp_with_result, norm_weights)
    loss_call_only   = -np.dot(logp_call_only,   norm_weights)
